name: Feedly
description: Team intelligence folders, AI Feeds, boards, articles, search, annotations, webhooks, and Enterprise intelligence workflows through Feedly's customer-token API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Feedly Enterprise API token, then let agents run bounded intelligence reads or the complete selected v3 API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FEEDLY_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Feedly Enterprise API access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate this in your own Enterprise team's API self-service page. Railway encrypts it and attaches it only to fixed-origin api.feedly.com requests.

capabilities.label: Read intelligence
capabilities.description: Read the profile, team folders, and bounded pages from selected AI Feed, folder, or board streams.

capabilities.label: Full Feedly API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented v3 API authorized by the customer's Enterprise token.

allowed.label: Collect articles
allowed.description: Collect a bounded page from a selected Feedly stream.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Feedly API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Feedly v3 operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded profile, folder, and article reads run directly; every other operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, token authority, fixed origin, bounds, audits, provider terms, and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Feedly tools and proxies the customer token server-side.
Railway mounts selected Feedly tools and proxies the customer token server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: A Feedly Enterprise admin enables the API add-on and generates a customer-owned token; the user enters it in Relay and selects capabilities plus Safe or Dangerous policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: Current API access uses customer-generated bearer tokens, is available only to Enterprise clients, requires account admin rights, and includes up to 100,000 requests per month.
The current REST API uses HTTPS at api.feedly.com, JSON, GET/POST/DELETE operations, and bounded continuation pagination.
Authenticated collection from AI Feed, folder, or board stream IDs supports counts from 1 to 100 and continuation pagination.
Mutations, OPML use, and bulk import/export require explicit user action or permission; developer keys are non-transferable and publisher monetization must be preserved.
